Use case: style-transfer. This is the ONE final targeted revision of image 1, a generated medieval RPG head portrait, for a 74x100 low-resolution dialogue portrait. Redraw meaningfully, not a resize. Input 1 is the edit target and identity baseline, already redrawn from the viewed character mother image; inputs 2–5 are Mara, Iwo, Leiya and Tore coarse-cluster style references only, never copy their faces. Retain subject identity, three-quarter direction, hairstyle, ear, head outline and specified clothing. Critical shared fixes: replace bright white eye patches with TINY deep-set dark eyes, narrow lids, and only a subdued brown-gray sclera sliver roughly one pixel wide at target size. No white or ivory in eyes, no catchlights, no mascara. Reduce both eye heights; the warm skin planes must be much lighter than the eyes. Use three or four broad flat skin planes; no tiny decorative freckle/noise patches. Broad readable nose bridge/side and cheekbone structure. Merge fine parallel hair stripes into 4–6 irregular broad interlocking dark/brown masses with a few stepped highlights; no evenly spaced comb stripes. Merge collar's fine textile texture into two or three large flat planes. Hard coarse pixel-cluster silhouette, not smooth painterly illustration, not a posterized photoreal portrait; no dither, blur, gradients, thin line hatching or surface noise. Transparent background. At most 32 flat muted earthy colors. Large head, SHORT neck and NARROW collar: head fills most of height, collar only bottom 6–8 target pixels. Entire hair, bun/braid and ear are fully visible, with REAL transparent margin in the GENERATED source: portrait silhouette width no more than 88% canvas, at least 4 target-pixel-equivalent transparent margin left and right, at least 4 top and 3 bottom. Never crop then add padding; all hair genuinely drawn before the edge. No chest, torso, hands, props, symbols, labels or frame.

ARO, WOMAN ABOUT 40 YEARS OLD: current v1 looks too youthful and its inner eyebrows lift into a worried/angry stock expression. Preserve broad cheekbones, short wide nose, warm ochre skin, deep brown side-part hair and short nape braid, gaze toward viewer left. Make her visibly middle-aged through firm lower-eyelid bags, subtle crow's-foot planes and two broad nasolabial shadow planes; retain strong female cheek/jaw structure, not an old crone or young heroine. Set thick eyebrows low and mostly level, relax the upward inner ends. Quiet steady map-keeper's composure, small relaxed closed mouth with candid slight asymmetry, not smiling, frowning, sad, angry or worried. Her mature presence should be recognized at actual 74x100 scale. Latest card clothing is deep charcoal-brown keeper's garment: very narrow dark collar with a tiny worn warm-gray inner edge. No green cloak or bulky hood. Tight head portrait only.
